_doc: Film render options every render request carries into its job (render-request.sh -> job.blur; tools/experience/RENDER-QUEUE.md). FILM_BLUR: render-cut.cjs --blur, sub-frames per film frame at 30 fps; the last half are blended (180-degree shutter) and only those are baked (render-shutter.cjs): 4 = 2 taps over 8.3 ms, 8 = 4 taps over 12.5 ms at the same cost. The value is not in the chapter keys: changing it needs a render-epoch bump, or the render PC's cache serves chapters rendered at the old value.
